lf: LF: To multiply a 4-digit number by a 1-digit number using short multiplication.
ican1: I can multiply a 4-digit number by a 1-digit number using short multiplication.
ican2: I can regroup correctly and estimate to check my answer is reasonable.

lf: LF: To identify which operation a word problem needs and explain why.
ican1: I can identify which operation a problem needs.
ican2: I can use signal words to find the operation.

lf: LF: To solve word problems by identifying the operation first, then calculating.
ican1: I can follow the two-step routine.
ican2: I can solve word problems using all four operations.

lf: LF: To plan and solve two-step problems using a bar model.
ican1: I can use a bar model to plan a two-step problem.
ican2: I can work through steps in the correct order.

lf: LF: To solve problems in money and measurement contexts by choosing the right operation.
ican1: I can solve money and measurement problems.
ican2: I can include the correct unit in every answer.

lf: LF: To interpret data presented in pictograms, bar charts and tables.
ican1: I can read values from pictograms and bar charts using the scale.
ican2: I can read data accurately from rows and columns of a table.

lf: LF: To compare data sets and calculate the sum and difference between values.
ican1: I can identify whether a question asks for a sum or a difference.
ican2: I can calculate accurately from data shown in charts or tables.

lf: LF: To read and interpret line graphs, including estimating between labelled points.
ican1: I can read values at labelled points and estimate between labels.
ican2: I can describe the trend shown by a line graph.
